programme.desc: Los Pearson son una familia que llega a una casa para pasar las vacaciones de verano. Su periodo de descanso se verá alterado por cuatro alienígenas que llegaron antes que ellos.

programme.title: Super Papá Oso
programme.desc: Papá Oso, un padre soltero que vive por y para su pequeño, le confiesa el día de su cumpleaños que su madre nunca volverá… justo antes de que unos cazadores furtivos irrumpan para llevarse al osezno muy lejos él. ¿Qué hará Papá Oso para recuperar al pequeño?

programme.title: Kika Superbruja y el libro de hechizos
programme.desc: Kika es una niña normal que un día encuentra un libro de magia y empieza a vivir sorprendentes aventuras en compañía de un pequeño dragón llamado Héctor.

programme.title: Air Bud 2: El Fichaje De La Liga
programme.desc: Buddy tiene un nuevo truco bajo la zarpa: fútbol americano. Cuando el dueño de Buddy se convierte en el siguiente quarterback de su escuela, Buddy va con la corriente también. La explosiva unión de Buddy y Josh consigue llevar a los Timberwolves al campeonato estatal.

programme.title: Vendaval
programme.desc: Una niña que piensa que no es buena para hacer nada tiene que quedarse a pasar las vacaciones con su abuela en una caballeriza. Allí descubre su interés en los caballos, la equitación y las cosas que están hechas para ella.

programme.title: Alvin y las ardillas 3
programme.desc: Tercera entrega de la saga Alvin y las ardillas. Las ardillas se embarcan en un crucero de lujo y acaban en una isla desierta, pero pronto averiguarán que no está tan desierta como parece.

programme.title: Las Hermanas Vampiras
programme.desc: Dakaria y Silvania son dos hermanas mellizas de 12 años que se trasladan con sus padres a una ciudad alemana para empezar una nueva vida. Nada de particular, si no fuera porque su su madre es humana, el padre un vampiro, y las dos hijas no solo son mitad humano, mitad vampiros.

programme.title: Las Hermanas Mágicas
programme.desc: Basado en la serie de libros de Sheridan Winn "Sprite Sisters", sobre las aventuras mágicas de las hermanas Flame, Sky, Flora y Marina.

programme.title: Jóvenes extraordinarios
programme.desc: Tres niños especiales con carencias en sus habilidades mágicas -un vampiro que no puede ver sangre, un hada con miedo a volar y un hombre lobo alérgico al pelo de los animales-, se enfrentan a un oponente infernal y ganan la mayor de todas las victorias posibles: aceptarse a sí mismos como son.

programme.title: Yakari
programme.desc: Cuando la migración de su tribu es inminente, Yakari, el pequeño Sioux, parte a lo desconocido para seguir el rastro de Petit-Tonnerre, un mustang de fama de indomable. En el camino, Yakari tendrá un encuentro mágico con el Gran Águila, su animal totem.

programme.title: Monkey Business
programme.desc: Wim, de nueve años, vive en un orfanato y sueña con ir a la escuela. En lugar de eso es obligado a trabajar en el sótano del orfanato fabricando escobas ilegales.

programme.title: Chestnut: el hero de Central Park
programme.desc: Las jóvenes hermanas huérfanas Sal y Rae creen que les ha tocado el gordo cuando encuentran un adorable cachorrito de Gran Danés, justo el mismo día en que han sido adoptadas...

programme.title: S1:E7 Episodios 19-21 - Louie

programme.title: S1:E8 Episodios 22-24 - Louie
programme.desc: Louie, dibújame un canguro | Louie, dibújame un elefante | Louie, dibújame un globo aerostático

programme.desc: Louie, dibújame un camión de bomberos | Louie, dibújame un castor | Louie, dibújame una rana

programme.title: S1:E10 Episodios 28-30 - Louie
programme.desc: Louie, dibújame una ardilla | Louie, dibújame un árbol | Louie, dibújame un pastel

programme.title: S1:E11 Episodios 31-33 - Louie
programme.desc: Louie, dibújame un castillo | Louie, dibújame un león | Louie, dibújame un león marino

programme.title: S1:E12 Episodios 34-36 - Louie
programme.desc: Louie, dibújame un pelícano | Louie, dibújame un piano | Louie, dibújame un reno

programme.title: S2:E4 Una Monada de Gatito - LoliRock
programme.desc: Las princesas se encuentran con un adorable gatito que necesita un hogar y se lo llevan a casa, para disgusto de Amaru.

programme.title: S2:E5 Rojo Hechizante - LoliRock
programme.desc: Auriana consigue un contrato de modelo para el champú Rosa Roja y le pagarán con un suministro de champú de por vida.

programme.title: S2:E6 Visión Borrosa - LoliRock
programme.desc: La tía Ellen le entrega a Iris un cristal mágico que estaba en la cesta en la que Iris fue depositada en el porche de su casa.

programme.title: Tom y Jerry: Aventura en el tiempo
programme.desc: ¡Tom y Jerry viajan en el tiempo! Tras una loca persecución en el Museo Metropolitan de Nueva York, un portal del tiempo los transporta a una ciudad dorada inspirada en la Antigua China, llena de magia, guerreros y criaturas sorprendentes.

programme.title: Aventura en la isla
programme.desc: Tres hermanas pequeñas son arrastradas por la marea hasta una isla deshabitada. Allí quedarán atrapadas en una cueva cuya única salida está bloqueada por olas gigantes.

programme.title: Yakari
programme.desc: Cuando la migración de su tribu es inminente, Yakari, el pequeño Sioux, parte a lo desconocido para seguir el rastro de Petit-Tonnerre, un mustang de fama de indomable. En el camino, Yakari tendrá un encuentro mágico con el Gran Águila, su animal totem.

programme.title: Los Cachorros De Buddy
programme.desc: Cuando Emma, la nueva chica guapa, se une al equipo de fútbol de los chicos, Josh y Buddy deciden que este es el año para jugar al fútbol. Mientras Josh y Emma se van conociendo, Buddy y el perro de Emma, Molly, comienzan a escabullirse por la noche para verse.

programme.title: Air Bud: Super Estrella
programme.desc: La solitaria vida de un chico cambia completamente cuando se hace amigo de un perro nada ordinario que le enseña a jugar al baloncesto.

programme.title: Vicky el Vikingo
programme.desc: La historia de un joven vikingo que acompaña a su padre, el jefe del pueblo, y a sus hombres en sus aventuras, y que, a menudo, es el que los saca de todos los apuros gracias a su ingenio y su instinto.

programme.title: Alpha y Omega
programme.desc: Humphrey, un lobo de la clase Omega pasa sus días haciendo chistes y esta enamorado por una loba de clase Alpha, Julieta. El problema es que Alphas y Omegas no pueden casarse!

programme.title: Alvin y las ardillas: Fiesta sobre ruedas
programme.desc: Las tres ardillas parlanchinas y estrellas de la canción vuelven de nuevo junto con su amigo Dave. A través de una serie de malentendidos las ardillas creen que Dave va a declararse a su nueva novia y a olvidarse de ellos. Tienen tres días para tratar de romper el compromiso, y no perder a Dave.

programme.title: La Senda de los Forajidos: El Tesoro de Butch Cassidy
programme.desc: Roy, nieto del famoso ladrón de bancos Butch Cassidy, emprende una búsqueda del tesoro oculto por su abuelo.

programme.title: Monkey Business
programme.desc: Wim, de nueve años, vive en un orfanato y sueña con ir a la escuela. En lugar de eso es obligado a trabajar en el sótano del orfanato fabricando escobas ilegales.

programme.title: Storm Y La Carta Prohibida De Lutero
programme.desc: Storm Voeten, hijo del copista Klaas Voeten, se convierte en la diana de una cacería de la Inquisición. Ayudado por Marieke, una misteriosa chica que vive en las cloacas subterráneas de Antwerp, Storm es capturado en una carrera contrarreloj para salvar a su padre.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya y el Orbe Dorado
programme.desc: Cuando Maya, una pequeña abeja testaruda, y su mejor amigo Willi, rescatan a una princesa hormiga, se encuentran en medio de una épica batalla de insectos que los llevará a mundos nuevos y extraños que pondrán a prueba su amistad hasta el límite...

programme.title: S01 : E02 Low Carbs, No Problems - The Urban Vegetarian
programme.desc: Host Desiree Nielsen shows us low-carb options for any meal of the day. Buckwheat pancakes smothered in blueberries? Yes, please!

programme.title: S03 : E09 Martha Stewart Part 1 - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Martha: The Cookbook by Martha Stewart! Follow along as Shahir prepares duck breast with sour cherry sauce and Persian rice, scalloped potatoes, and gougeres!

programme.title: S01 : E09 Lombardy - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini prepares traditional dishes from the Northern Italian region, Lombardy.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Seafood Skewers & Sweet, Smoky Salsa - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are back at the barn with smoky flavours, fresh ideas, and BBQ favourites! On this episode, they make crab cakes with smoky peach salsa, grill swordfish and scallop skewers with curried corn sauce, and toss a grilled vegetable couscous salad.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Mediterranean Grill & Barnyard Thrills - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Fresh ingredients meet bold BBQ flavours as Maddie and Kiki put a smoky spin on Mediterranean favourites. They smoke heirloom tomatoes for a basil and bocconcini salad, glaze grilled mushroom kebabs with balsamic, and finish with juicy lamb souvlaki served alongside cool tzatziki.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Trentino-Alto Adige - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Lettuce Eat Lasagna - The Urban Vegetarian
programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen shows how salads can be a tasty main AND served warm with a grilled romaine salad.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Apples and Anchovies - A is for Apple
programme.desc: In an "A" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas makes apple fritters and fried anchovies. But how will she combine these distinct flavours in the same dish?

programme.title: S01 : E10 Veneto - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Home to popular Italian dishes like Tiramisu, Chef Michael Bonacini explores cuisine from Italy's Veneto region.

programme.title: S01 : E28 Cashews and Carrots - A is for Apple
programme.desc: Chef Lauren Gulyas tests her imagination with cashews and carrots. First, she makes cashew chicken and carrot cupcakes. But how will she combine them?

programme.title: S01 : E03 Salty - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Meaty prawns and melt-in-your-mouth cod are on the menu as trendy chef and seafood expert Spencer Watts gets a little "salty" with seafood.

programme.title: S01 : E02 No Ham, No Problem - VEGANnotvegan
programme.desc: A classic Croque Monsieur gets a plant-based makeover with rutabaga “ham” and creamy cashew sauce, served alongside a fresh side salad. Can the vegan version deliver the same French comfort? Join Maddie and Kiki to find out!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Moules Frites - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Crack open a mussel or two, this episode of Up the Dish begins in Belgium, but please, no waffles! Host Micah Trainor makes Moules- Frites, mussels steamed in white wine and shows her trick for bistro- style French fries. Next, Tiera Singh steals the show with her Mussel Broth Vichyssoise and Smoked Mussels, an ultra-creamy cold soup that's paired with smoky shellfish for fantastic flavour. Vegetarian mussels? Missy Hui says "no worries!" and makes Saffron Artichokes with zesty Lemon Chili Oil - there's a little bit of everything in each delectable bite! How does Poppy Sandler send the episode off? By turning it on its head! Fried mussels with Celeriac Remoulade salad makes for a satisfying ending to Up the Dish.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Smoked Seafood & Sister Sass - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mexico + Norway - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Summer Fun - MORE One Big Recipe

programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are mixing bold marinades and fresh summer flavours for another unforgettable BBQ feast! They grill stout-marinated pork tenderloin with a tangy buttermilk potato salad, turn sweet cantaloupe into a smoky side, and spice things up with tandoori cauliflower.

programme.title: S02 : E13 Summery Melon & Ribs Two Ways - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: It’s all about ribs as Maddie and Kiki show two delicious ways to master the BBQ! They make quick dry jerk baby back ribs, slow-cook ribs with a sticky guava glaze, pair them with vibrant Caribbean and beet salads, and cool things off with refreshing melon treats.

programme.title: S02 : E14 Lemony Clams & Porterhouse Feast - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Surf, turf, and summer desserts share the spotlight as Maddie and Kiki build a BBQ menu full of bold flavours. They grill clams with lemon butter, toss a chicory and chorizo salad, cook a porterhouse steak with chimichurri, and bake a rustic wild berry crisp.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mexico + Norway - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Summer Fun - MORE One Big Recipe
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of baked feta with marinated tomatoes and corn chips, a marinated tomato and jicama salad with cilantro lime dressing, carne molida tacos, and a sous-vide crème caramel.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Tailgate Feast: Gameday Grub - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: Game day traditions meet sizzling creativity as familiar favorites hit the griddle. From sliders to smoky wings, these dishes celebrate casual gatherings and the inventive ways home chefs turn everyday ingredients into shareable, crowd-pleasing bites.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Southern Smoke & Sizzlin' Sides - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn

programme.title: S01 : E05 Meatloaf, Venison & Country Comforts - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Fun-loving sisters and expert grillmasters Maddie and Kiki welcome you into their country barn for craveable eats and spicy jokes! On this episode, they show you how to smoke a meatloaf, make a potato salad that will have everyone asking for the recipe, and grill up savory venison chops!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Cluck, Chops & Summer Sides - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Fun-loving sisters and expert grillmasters Maddie and Kiki welcome you into their country barn for craveable eats and spicy jokes! On this episode, they smoke a whole chicken, whip up summery corn and watermelon sides, and share the wonder that is onion water lamb chops!

programme.title: S01 : E05 Cassoulet - Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Carrot Cake - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Borscht - Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: S01 : E08 Seafood Boil - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Micah Trainor boils it down for this episode of Up the Dish! Her Cajun Seafood Boil simmers with luscious lobster, smoky andouille, and supERS-sized crab; a perfect blend of zesty, spicy, and succulent. It's a hard act to follow, but Missy Hui is up for it. Her Corned Beef Boiled Dinner is a call back to the Emerald Isle - home-cured pickled beef bubbles away with veggies in a beefy broth. Poppy Sandler's vegetarian addition? Moroccan Vegetable Stew! A North African-style spice blend heats this dish up, while chickpeas and other veggies soak up the flavour. Tiera Singh takes a spicy approach with her one-pot delight - Guyanese Pepperpot. Loaded with scotch-bonnet peppers, osso bucco, and demi-glace, this dish delivers a rich and impressive punch to the tastebuds.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Have Fun - Generation Cooks
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make avocado toast and tacos, Liam whips up an easy pantry pasta, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a favorite one pot meal!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Sharing Is Caring - Generation Cooks
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs prep rainbow fruit skewers, Liam whips up his charity-inspired cheeseburger soup, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a popular Trinidadian street food, fried bread and saltfish!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Everybody’s A Chef - Generation Cooks
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make pancakes, Liam whips up craveable chicken coconut curry, Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make Nashville fried chicken sandwiches, and more!

programme.title: S01 : E04 You Got It - Generation Cooks
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs test kitchen hacks with eggs, Liam whips up the beef and broccoli stir fry he made for friends as a kid, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a beautiful pistachio pasta and Caesar salad!

programme.title: S02 : E09 Fast Favs - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: For a quick and tasty meal, chef Spencer Watts cooks up fast favs using scallops and trout, all done in under 30 minutes.

programme.title: S02 : E10 Fruit - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts mixes the sweet flavours of fruit with fish as he makes dishes with salmon and scallops.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Dairy - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Seafood and dairy make the perfect partners. Watch as Chef Spencer Watts creates some dairy-infused dishes using red snapper and scampi.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Tart - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts makes tastebuds dance as he creates recipes that combine sour and tart flavours with grouper and clams.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup - Up the Dish
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: S01 : E10 Veal Piccata - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Yellow - VegHeadz
programme.desc: Say hello to yellow with chef Pino Di Cerbo as he brightens each dish with glowing, golden-hued produce! Corn on the cob gets a fun presentation as 'ribs', chopped into spears, spiked with harissa spices, and grilled until smoky. Next is a sweet and sour detour with mangoes and lemons in a no-bake cheesecake with a unique popped amaranth crust. Next, aromatic and hearty Kerala-style curry includes all things gold and beautiful: creamy yellow potatoes, sweet yellow peppers, even snappy yellow beans! Finally, stick around for a Thai-inspired noodle salad, where even the noodles are veggies! Strands of mildly sweet spaghetti squash paired with nutty cashews, tender sprouts and a punchy ginger-rice vinaigrette!

Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.desc: Boo! Did that scare you? If so, then you better steer clear of this super spooky Holiday Eatz Halloween episode with chef-host Kimberly Lallouz! But that would be too bad, because then you'd miss a menu featuring fun but grown-up Halloween eats like Jack O'Lantern Curry, served with Irish-inspired spiced Pumpkin Barmbrack bread. Next, you'd miss a ghostly surprise with her pan seared Black Cod buried in a pile of carrot-chip 'Autumn Leaves' and drizzled with mango sauce made with"... ghost peppers! Her 'Fet Ghede' (Haitian Day of the Dead) inspired beef rib follows"... with a rib bone connected to"... melting tender beef braised in Haiti's signature Epis spice and crunched-up with yummy pumpkin seeds. For a sweet ending, it's a 'Bag of Candy'"... or in this case, homemade profiterole stuffed with mascarpone and all of your favourite candies! See, that wasn't so scary, was it? Mwahahahaha!

programme.desc: Chef Dev prepares some of his favorite street food dishes from around the world that feature legumes, including “Brat’s Foot” Peanut Brittle from Brazil, Koshari from Egypt, and Haleem Stew from Pakistan.

programme.title: S01 : E20 Chicken or the Egg - Global Street Eats
programme.desc: Which came first, the chicken or the egg? Chef Dev tries to answer this age-old question while preparing Chicken Lahori from Pakistan, Egg Balls from Guyana, and Egg Battered Chicken Feet inspired by Chinese Dim Sum.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Avocados and Apricots - A is for Apple
programme.desc: "A" is on the menu and Chef Robert Jewell takes on this meal challenge with apricots and avocados. First up, Robert cooks a spicy roasted quail and drizzles it with some sweet apricot and calvados sauce. Next, is a meal best served cold! Robert slices up sushi-grade tuna and transforms it into a flavourful tartare, brought to life by rich avocado and refreshing lime. On the side, he adds crusty crostini with savoury soy sauce and sesame oil, the perfect complement for this meltin- your-mouth meal. For his final dish, Robert combines apricots and avocados for an unbelievably tasty dish.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Dill and Duck - A is for Apple
programme.desc: Host Theresa Visintin picks the letter “D” in this challenge and combines two very different ingredients – dill and duck! But that’s no big dill for Theresa. For her first dish, Theresa uses dill seeds and weed to make a hearty, creamy dill pickle soup. She adds chicken broth and potatoes as her base but makes the soup extra smooth with some sour cream. She tops the soup with dill pickles to add a delightful crunch. Next, Theresa takes duck, a classic French ingredient, and gives it a French Canadian twist – duck tourtière. Using the duck fat to fry up some veggies, she adds red wine to her chicken stock and simmers the meat. Then, Theresa fills a pie crust with this delightful duck filling and coats the crust with egg wash before baking it to a golden brown. Finally, Theresa takes on both ingredients to create a delectable dill and duck dish.

Concerto - OSN Marc Albrecht E Simone Lamsma Torino
programme.sub-title: Concerto - OSN Marc Albrecht E Simone Lamsma Torino
programme.desc: In this 2022 concert in Turin, Marc Albrecht conducts the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai, with Simone Lamsma as the violin soloist. The programme includes Shostakovich's Violin Concerto No. 1, showcasing Lamsma's technical brilliance and emotional depth, and Franck's Symphony in D minor, celebrated for its rich harmonies and cyclical structure. The performance highlights a powerful blend of passion and precision.

programme.title: Whats on Food and Culinary Delights
programme.sub-title: Whats on Food and Culinary Delights
programme.desc: Taste the Mediterranean this week on Whats On. Malta celebrates with Festa Frawli, the Malta International Food Festival, and Festival Ikel Malti. Slovenia serves fine dining at Gourmet Ljubljana, while Italy CousCous Festival blends flavors and cultures. programme.title: S01:E12 Gold Cuisine EP 12 - Gold Cuisine
programme.desc: A sweet and comforting duo with skillet apple pie, warm and fragrant with tender apples and buttery crust, paired with soft, chocolatey crinkle cookies. An episode celebrating indulgent desserts and the cozy flavors of home baking.

programme.title: S01:E07 Dalmatian Brunch Ep 7 - Split (Firule)
programme.desc: In Split’s Firule neighborhood—home to Croatia’s tennis greats—we discovered more than just sport. Renowned chef Hrvoje Zirojević welcomed us with a taste of tradition: pivac na tingul, a classic Dalmatian stew made with tender young rooster.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Lisbon
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Lisbon, the vibrant capital of Portugal. Once founded by the Phoenicians and shaped by Romans, Moors, and explorers of the Golden Age, Lisbon’s layered history is reflected in its culture and charm. During her visit, the city comes alive with the Festas Populares de Lisboa — a June celebration of Saint Anthony filled with music, dancing, and barbecued sardines. Malini samples local favorites like grilled sardines, bifanas, and the famous pastel de nata, and experiences the soulful beauty of Fado music. Lisbon’s warmth, flavor, and festive spirit show why it remains one of Europe’s most beloved cities.

programme.title: La Firenze dei Medici
programme.desc: Explore the profound influence of the Medici family on the history of Florence, highlighting their rule from the 15th to the 16th century. The focus is on Lorenzo Il Magnifico, the era's most renowned figure. Through his life, we delve into iconic works linked to the Medici, including the masterpiece of architecture, the Dome of Santa Maria del Fiore, designed by Filippo Brunelleschi. The episode also features Florence’s own Sergio Staino, a celebrated designer and cartoonist, offering a unique perspective on the city’s rich cultural legacy.

programme.title: Paestum e Velia colonie greche d' Occidente
programme.sub-title: Paestum e Velia colonie greche d' Occidente
programme.desc: A journey from Greece to Italy during the archaic era involved diverse human groups settling in Southern Italy, which led to the establishment of Magna Grecia. Discover the archaeological sites of Poseidonia, Paestum, and Elea, Velia, where recent excavations have uncovered ancient temples and artefacts, revealing the region's rich history of cultural exchange and maritime conflicts.

programme.desc: Stepping into Manuel's home feels like entering a living museum, filled with original furniture and handcrafted pieces created throughout his career. For more than 50 years, Manuel has dedicated himself to woodcraft, learning his trade from his mentor Paul Calleja, who studied woodworking in England and passed on his passion for the craft. In more recent years, Manuel also discovered the value of discarded timber, giving old wood a new purpose and transforming forgotten materials into unique works of art. Fadi explores his remarkable joumey and the craftsmanship behind a lifetime spent working with wood.

programme.title: Madame Butterfly Teatro Alla Scala 2016
programme.desc: In Madama Butterfly (Teatro alla Scala, 2016), a young Japanese woman enters into a marriage with an American naval officer, filled with hope for a new life. As time passes, the contrast between her expectations and reality becomes more profound. The opera unfolds with deep emotional intensity, leading to a powerful and poignant conclusion.

programme.title: Whats On Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.sub-title: Whats On Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Mediterranean Kitchen Tunisia
programme.desc: Chef Kurt welcomes Chef Rania to prepare a vibrant Tunisian masterpiece: fluffy, spice-infused couscous served with melt-in-your-mouth tender lamb and slow-simmered vegetables. While the aromatic steam fills the kitchen, the two dive into the bold flavours of North Africa and the personal stories behind Rania’s family recipes. It’s an authentic celebration of heat, heritage, and the comfort of home cooking.

programme.title: S01:E05 Dalmatian Brunch EP 5 - Sinj
programme.desc: Sinj blends courage, tradition, and warm hospitality—reflected even in its food. Edo Crljen welcomed us with a bold serving of tripes, while Ankica Vlastelica prepared the town’s pride: arambaši, Sinj’s iconic stuffed cabbage rolls you simply can’t leave without tasting.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Andalucia
programme.desc: Join Angelica Malini on an unforgettable journey through Andalucía, southern Spain’s most colorful and captivating region, as they explore Cordoba and Cadiz. Famous for flamenco, tapas, and stunning Moorish architecture, Andalucía’s rich history comes alive here. In Cordoba, the host marvels at the breathtaking Mezquita, a grand mosque turned cathedral. In Cadiz, an ancient Phoenician city, they soak in sweeping Atlantic views and a corniche with hints of North Africa. This episode immerses viewers in the culture, history, and vibrant spirit of one of Spain’s most enchanting regions.

programme.title: Colours of Mediterranean Culture
programme.desc: From Malta to Greece, Mediterranean arts flourish. Valletta Baroque Festival, Malta International Arts Festival, and Birgu by Candlelight light up the island with music and heritage. Italy’s Cortona on the Move, La Fenice in Piazza San Marco, and Mercantia Festival showcase photography, opera, and street performance. France’s Art Paris and International Garden Festival, Spain’s Revela’t Festival and La Leyenda de Tartessos, Portugal’s Umbrella Sky Project and Walk & Talk Biennale, Turkey’s Istanbul Theatre Festival and Biennial, and Greece’s Athens & Epidaurus Festival highlight the Med’s rich artistic tapestry.

programme.title: S01:E07 Made in Med: Craft of Wood Sculpture - Made in Med: Craft of Wood Sculpture
programme.sub-title: Made in Med: Craft of Wood Sculpture
programme.desc: Stepping into Manuel's home feels like entering a living museum, filled with original furniture and handcrafted pieces created throughout his career. For more than 50 years, Manuel has dedicated himself to woodcraft, learning his trade from his mentor Paul Calleja, who studied woodworking in England and passed on his passion for the craft. In more recent years, Manuel also discovered the value of discarded timber, giving old wood a new purpose and transforming forgotten materials into unique works of art. Fadi explores his remarkable joumey and the craftsmanship behind a lifetime spent working with wood.

programme.desc: Barcelona fue el lienzo del arquitecto de renombre mundial Antoni Gaudí, quien marcó la ciudad con sus fantásticas creaciones.

programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E21 Espacios en la Ciudad Narlai & Jawai - City Breaks
programme.desc: La necesidad de un breve y refrescante descanso lleva a Asmita a una pintoresca aldea en Rajasthan, donde la vida no parece haber cambiado mucho desde el siglo XV. Por un lado, prueba el lujo en lo que una vez fue la mansión de caza de la realeza de Jodhpur y, por otro lado, se entrega al estilo de vida sencillo de los residentes de las aldeas cercanas. Sin embargo, lo más destacado de su viaje es una sorpresa que le espera en un antiguo pozo escalonado.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Costa Rica te llama Corcovado - Costa Rica Calling
programme.desc: Guiada por un irresistible llamado a la aventura, la joven viajera estadounidense Genevieve Sexton se adentra en las profundidades de Costa Rica.

programme.desc: Lugares secretos para bucear, lagunas ocultas, antiguas ruinas mayas: hay mucho más en la península de Yucatán que Cancún y Playa del Carmen.

programme.desc: Ya sea el acuario marino más grande de Europa o una plaza de toros, Alex encuentra la elegancia moderna de España y el encanto del viejo mundo en Valencia.

programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Guía XP Oslo 1, Noruega - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Oslo es la más antigua de las capitales escandinavas; Con una rica historia que se remonta a más de 1000 años, los monumentos icónicos de la ciudad revelan a los visitantes su evolución a través de los tiempos. Elisha realiza un recorrido para ver algunos de ellos, como el magnífico Castillo de Arkeshus, un castillo medieval que fue construido para proteger Oslo pero que en su lugar se usó como prisión, y el Ayuntamiento de Oslo, el centro administrativo de la ciudad que alberga la entrega anual del Nobel. Ceremonia del premio de la paz.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Mochila Eilat, Israel - Backpack
programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Herencia Mundial Delhi - World Heritage
programme.desc: Hojee las páginas de la historia mientras se propone explorar y comprender la arquitectura de los monumentos islámicos construidos a partir del siglo XI en Delhi.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Viajar Mexico Cancun - Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Lugares secretos para bucear, lagunas ocultas, antiguas ruinas mayas: hay mucho más en la península de Yucatán que Cancún y Playa del Carmen.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Spas del Mundo Evason Ma'in, Jordán - World Spas

programme.title: S01 : E52 Guía XP Muscat - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Muscat, que se extiende a lo largo de casi 25 kilómetros a lo largo de la costa de Omán, combina el glamour del nuevo mundo y el encanto del viejo mundo para brindar a los visitantes una muestra de la verdadera Arabia.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Guía XP Oslo 2, Noruega - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Quizás el período más famoso de la historia de Noruega fue la época vikinga. Lejos de ser simples invasores bárbaros y con hachas, los vikingos eran marinos nórdicos que dejaron un gran impacto en la historia europea a través del comercio, la colonización y la exploración remota. Durante la visita de Elisha a Oslo, queda asombrada por los extraordinarios y bien diseñados barcos vikingos en un museo, donde conoce historias fascinantes sobre la vida de los vikingos.

programme.desc: Para el pueblo de Sofía, preservar su patrimonio es sacrosanto, y esto se puede ver en la forma en que la infraestructura de la ciudad está construida alrededor de sus tesoros arqueológicos. Catriona se da cuenta de ello cuando deambula por las calles adoquinadas de la ciudad. Con cada monumento que visita, se siente transportada a una época diferente, desde el fuerte Perperikon, que narra historias del imperio bizantino, hasta la iglesia de Boyana, que alberga algunos de los primeros ejemplos de arte medieval.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Bután Paro - Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Con picos nevados que se elevan sobre bosques primitivos y pueblos tradicionales, Paro es como una Suiza oriental. En una visita a Paro, Radhika explora monasterios famosos como el Rinpung Dzong y el Monasterio Takstang, y aprende la historia y las leyendas asociadas con ellos. En el camino, descubre los secretos de la paz y la satisfacción por excelencia de Bután.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora Bután Thimpu - Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Radhika Bangia, actriz y entusiasta de los viajes, explora el enigma de Bután cuando visita Thimpu, la capital sin semáforos ni rascacielos que invadan el horizonte. Aquí, visita lugares importantes como el Monumento Nacional Chorten de estilo tibetano, la Biblioteca Nacional y el Museo del Patrimonio Folclórico para comprender más sobre las creencias, la historia, la arquitectura y la cocina de Bután.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Patrimoine de l’humanité Portugal - World Heritage
programme.desc: De l'impact du commerce maritime et de la Renaissance européenne sur le Portugal au XVe siècle au mouvement national du romantisme au XIXe siècle, les sites patrimoniaux du Portugal tels que le monastère des Hiéronymites et le palais de Pena révèlent différentes étapes de l'évolution du pays.

programme.desc: Desde un antiguo y bullicioso mercado victoriano hasta el museo del Titanic Belfast, Olivia conoce las diferentes caras de Belfast a través de los lugares que visita.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Bután Phobjikha - Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Conocido como Druk Yul o la "Tierra del Dragón del Trueno", Bután es el país de las montañas, los monasterios y el misterio. Radhika Bangia descubre que esto es cierto cuando visita Punakha, la antigua capital de Bután, donde se maravilla con la arquitectura de Punakha Dzong y conoce la historia detrás de los dos ríos, Mo Chhu y Po Chhu. También explora los templos sagrados y el lago Mebar Tsho de Bumthang, el corazón religioso de Bután, y conoce las leyendas locales.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Spas del Mundo Chiva Som, Tailandia - World Spas
programme.desc: Desde una terapia subacuática hasta un masaje desintoxicante de órganos internos, Jamie Srubis prueba variados tratamientos de spa en el resort Chiva Som de Tailandia.
